verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents a first-party self-hostable rendezvous/relay server (Server OSS) and peer-to-peer connections, so devices can connect without a vendor server; a long-time user also reports no account is needed. However, nothing documents local-network discovery of the host or a fully serverless direct connection, and one user reports it seemed to require a rendezvous/relay server with no direct IP connection. missing for 10: documented LAN host discovery, serverless direct-IP connection without any rendezvous server, first-party confirmation that no account is required

support.subject: As a power user, my devices find the host on the local network and connect without an account or a vendor server in between

citations.quote: Self-hosted ID/rendezvous and relay servers with Server OSS or Server Pro; clients connect peer to peer when they can and fall back to your relay.
You can use our rendezvous/relay server, set up your own, or write your own rendezvous/relay server.
no account BS, no vendor lock in
